step1_analysis.description: A continuous-time fully differential folded-cascode operational transconductance amplifier (OTA). Based on the paper context, this amplifier is used as a continuous-time common-mode feedback (CMFB) error amplifier to replace conventional switched-capacitor CMFB circuits for high-speed operation.

bias: N5 (VBP1 - PMOS current source bias / CMFB control)

paper_reference.title: Continuous-Time Common-Mode Feedback for High-Speed Switched-Capacitor Networks

paper_reported.technology: Not specified (likely 0.18um or similar based on year)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. gm ~ 358 uS (based on 21.5uA tail current per branch). Rout is the parallel combination of PMOS and NMOS cascode output resistances (~5.8 MOhm). Gain = 358uS * 5.8MOhm = 2076 V/V = 66 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be slightly higher than the paper's 59 dB due to ideal current source biasing in the testbench and SKY130 intrinsic gain characteristics.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm / (2 * pi * CL). With gm = 358 uS and CL = 1 pF, GBW = 358e-6 / (2 * 3.1415 * 1e-12) = 57 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches closely with the paper's reported 72 MHz, assuming a 1 pF load capacitance as stated in the abstract.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole at the folded node (N1, N3). Assuming parasitic capacitance at folded node is ~50fF and resistance is ~1/gm_cascode, the non-dominant pole is > 500 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A well-designed single-stage folded cascode with a 1 pF load typically exhibits a phase margin > 60 degrees.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = I_tail / CL. With I_tail ~ 43 uA (based on VBN1=0.6V) and CL = 1 pF, SR = 43 uA / 1 pF = 43 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly dependent on the tail current set by the bias voltage VBN1 and the load capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current = I_M8 + I_M11 = 64.5 uA + 64.5 uA = 129 uA. Power = 129 uA * 1.8 V = 232 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the estimated bias currents required to keep all transistors in saturation with the given W/L ratios.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, differential AC gain, GBW, phase margin, and transient slew rate of the fully differential folded-cascode OTA. An ideal behavioral CMFB is included to stabilize the output common-mode voltage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential Folded-Cascode OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N4 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 LABEL_NET_0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N7 LABEL_NET_1 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N6 LABEL_NET_3 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N8 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N7 LABEL_NET_4 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N3 LABEL_NET_5 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N3 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Power Supply and Biases
VDD VDD 0 1.8
VBN1 N0 0 0.6
VBN2_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VBN2_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9
VBP2_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.5
VBP2_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.5

* Ideal Common-Mode Feedback (CMFB) to stabilize outputs to 0.9V
Bcmfb N5 0 V=0.88+20*((v(N6)+v(N7))/2-0.9)

* Input Signals
VCM VCM 0 0.9
VIND VIND 0 dc 0 ac 1 pulse(-0.5 0.5 5n 100p 100p 20n 40n)
E_INP LABEL_NET_2 VCM VIND 0 0.5
E_INN LABEL_NET_5 VCM VIND 0 -0.5

* Load Capacitors (1 pF as per paper)
CL1 N6 0 1p
CL2 N7 0 1p

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis (Gain, GBW, Phase Margin)
ac dec 20 10 10G
let vout_diff = v(N7) - v(N6)
let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff))
let phase = 180/PI * cph(vout_diff)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_gbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let pm = 180 + phase_at_gbw
print pm

* 3. Transient Analysis (Slew Rate)
tran 10p 50n
* Measure rise slew rate on OUTP (N7)
meas tran t_rise trig v(N7) val=0.6 rise=1 targ v(N7) val=1.2 rise=1
let sr_rise = (1.2 - 0.6) / t_rise
print sr_rise
* Measure fall slew rate on OUTN (N6)
meas tran t_fall trig v(N6) val=1.2 fall=1 targ v(N6) val=0.6 fall=1
let sr_fall = (1.2 - 0.6) / t_fall
print sr_fall

quit
.endc
.end
